name: express-meaning
description: A TODO list read through a ContextFrame. Calls magenticmarket.ai over CPCP for the frame list; serves no CPCP seam of its own.

role.name: FRONT
role.definition: The surface users see, and a bounded view onto what BACK holds. Serves no seam.
role.reified_how: This role in Node, against a BACK it does not deploy: it reads ContextFrames from the seam and renders them beside the user's own input, which is the bounded view.
role.not_a_pod_member: Reified OUTSIDE the unit's pod: it reaches the BACK over the internet at services scope, not across a pod network. That is why its calling manifest is 'dependency' and not 'pod_internal_dependencies' -- same role, different reach.
role.second_reification: This unit's other FRONT is cpcp/front/app.py inside magentic-market-ai-site, a pod member. One role, two reifications.

contract.note: The revision whose scope vocabulary this repo's manifests cite. Full SHA per repo-format rule 5.

scopes.note: One manifest, and it is a calling one. This repo serves no CPCP seam at any scope and joins no pod network, so the other three scopes get no directory -- a directory asserts a relation, and three empty ones would assert three that do not hold.

not_a_seam.public/: A browser UI. Static files, no RPC.
not_a_seam./api/todos, /api/contextframes, /api/pro: This app's own HTTP API, called only by its own page. It answers the never-raise envelope shape by choice -- one failure path for the client to learn -- but it is not JSON-RPC-LD, draws no /_cpcp route, publishes no CID, and nothing outside this repo calls it. Answering {ok, reason, because} does not make a surface a CPCP seam.
not_a_seam.the LLM: There is none. The app holds no key, names no model, and makes no outbound request on the prompt path; a person carries the prompt to Chrome AI Mode by hand. The only network call this app makes is the CPCP one declared under dependency.

gates..github/workflows/test.yml: Runs the suite offline, then boots the app against a dead CPCP_ORIGIN and asserts the fallback is labelled local -- that a frame served from disk is never presented as one served by the seam.
